experienceDirection: Default to a visually led, interaction-first experience with responsive motion, spatial depth, direct manipulation, ambient state, and memorable moments worth sharing; keep explanatory text concise and integrated into the experience, while allowing richer copy when the requested format—such as a landing page, CMS, publication, or narrative archive—depends on it, and leave technology and dependency choices to the lead.
